THE QUEUE WAS NEVER BLOCKED — IT WAS UNTRANSCRIBED. The Banshee Haven appendix names, pairs, rooms and characterises every one of them: the Cosplay Blacksmith and the model, the Bikini Model chaos agent and the novelist whose manuscript towers use coffee mugs as load-bearing columns, the Goth Priestess and her holly-bushed top, the Goth Rocker and the Ice Queen, the Goth Volleyball player and the Gyaru Librarian whose card-catalogue nightstand holds one filthier thing per drawer, alphabetised.

FOUR HAVE NOT YET CROSSED THE THRESHOLD. THE ROOMS ARE ALREADY ASSIGNED, because the house names its future and then goes to find it.
